answer: Duplicating identities means buying, planting, and tending new plots, so attack cost scales linearly with fake accounts while honest upkeep stays cheap. Sybil resistance comes from stake-weighted identity bonded to a physical orchard: each agent must plant and maintain a verifiable plot, where yarrow and juniper serve as living attestation markers logged by sensors. Forgers must outspend the entire orchard network in land, labor, and time, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0003's threat model.
